Subject: Starlight Labs pilot — onboarding & billing question

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team loved the latency profile and the routing options. We're excited to get a 30-day pilot started next week. Quick question on onboarding: our procurement team typically can't issue purchase orders for trials under $5k and they prefer invoice-only arrangements for pilots.

Can Redwood accept invoice-only billing (Net 30) for the pilot while we complete vendor setup? If not, what evidence or approvals would your procurement team need to allow a temporary invoice path?

I've attached our onboarding form and a short SOC2 summary to help with the intake.

Cheers,
Alex Li
Head of Platform Partnerships
Starlight Labs

Key asks:
- Can we do a 30–60 day invoice-only exception for new vendor pilots?

Alex — cc'd. Priya will outline our checklist; if it's feasible we'll follow Redwood's temporary-exception template.

Thanks,

Hi Ben — thanks for flagging. Alex — thanks for the attachments, helpful. Quick summary of where we stand from procurement:

1) Standard policy: new vendors require PO-based orders. Exceptions are allowed but must be time-boxed and documented.
2) Temporary invoice-only exceptions have been used for trials historically (30–60 days) under these guardrails:
   - Invoice cap: $5,000 total for the pilot period
   - Required evidence: completed vendor intake form (we have your onboarding form), W-9 or equivalent tax doc (if US entity), and a basic security summary (SOC2 summary OK for initial intake)
   - Finance sign-off: Revenue Ops (Marissa) or Finance must approve the temporary lane and set the account flag in the vendor portal so AP routes invoices correctly
   - Risk mitigation: Flag the customer account for 60-day follow-up to ensure a PO is created for production or payment is escalated to normal collection workflows

I can approve a 45-day invoice-only path for pilots up to $5k if Finance is comfortable. Marissa — can you sign off on the cap and the fallback process (we'll require a quick credit check if the pilot exceeds expected usage)?

If approved, we'll share a short temporary-exception template (I drafted a one-page doc) and ask Starlight to e-sign. Alex — can you confirm: 1) Starlight's tax jurisdiction (US or non-US), and 2) billing contact for AP?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement (Vendor Onboarding)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-temp-exception-template.docx

Ben / Priya / Alex — I spoke with Finance. We can approve a temporary invoice-only lane for Starlight's 30-day pilot under the following conditions:

- Cap: $5,000 total for the pilot period (Net 30)
- Signed temporary-exception form (Priya's template) completed and e-signed before service activation
- W-9 or equivalent tax doc on file (Alex to provide)
- SOC2 summary accepted for initial intake; full security questionnaire to follow if pilot moves to paid production
- AP routing: once the exception form is executed, Finance will set the vendor flag so invoices route to Accounts Payable with the temporary SLA.
- Follow-up: Procurement will schedule a 45-day review to confirm PO issuance or convert to standard billing.

Alex — if that works for you, Ben can coordinate the DocuSign link and we can start onboarding. Ben, please capture the signed exception and upload to the vendor record (Drive link preferred).

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations (Finance Liaison)
Redwood Inference
